title: Independent non-anchor position period prediction
rationale: This lane predeclares an absolute-position period rule before any new evidence is scored. It is not another public-anchor mining pass because discovery does not use known-plaintext anchors, additive fragment values, candidate words, routed key-material results, held-out anchor controls, or prior public-fragment structure screens.
prediction_target: Future independently sourced non-anchor K4 position observations should fall into one or more registered period residue classes at a rate exceeding seeded null and best-of-period controls before any candidate-word, route, or public-anchor-derived fragment scoring is performed.
discovery_inputs: Predeclared absolute-position period registry selected before scoring new observations
K4 one-based absolute position numbers only
No candidate words, additive key fragments, public known-plaintext anchors, or routed public-span scores
evaluation_inputs: Future source-documented non-anchor K4 position observations with source IDs, one-based positions, per-position notes, and rationale
Observation files initialized before evaluation and archived with their source review
Independent target positions that are not EAST, NORTHEAST, BERLIN, or CLOCK public-anchor fragments
controls: best-of-period null control across the registered period set
multiple-comparison correction across registered period targets
promotion remains blocked unless source-backed evidence is positive after the predeclared controls
